subject: Draft: stakeholder onboarding checklist & timeline for Acme Payments
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Draft: stakeholder onboarding checklist & timeline for Acme Payments

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed I put together a focused stakeholder checklist and a suggested close timeline so we can align expectations and owners. High-level goals are below; the full draft is attached as a Google Doc and a short slide deck with milestone dates.

Goal: get a 30-day pilot running in Q1 with a clear procurement window and a security review slot.

Draft milestones (top-level):
- Kickoff & tech discovery (owner: Acme / date: week of Jan 4)
- Security & compliance checkpoint (owner: Acme + Redwood sec; date: week of Jan 11)
- Pilot deployment and validation (owner: Solutions Eng; date: Jan 18–Feb 12)
- Procurement & contract signature (owner: Acme legal; date: target Jan 10–Jan 20)
- Go/No-go and rollout plan (owner: joint; date: Feb 15)

Ask: please review the attached checklist and timeline and highlight any missing stakeholders or dates by EOD Tue Dec 22. If the timeline above conflicts with your procurement window, flag the best target dates and I’ll update the doc.

Attachments: [Attachment: acmepay_stakeholder_checklist_v1.gdoc (Google Doc)], [Attachment: acmepay_close_timeline_v1.pptx]

Next steps I will take after your feedback:
- Incorporate security/legal owners and proposed dates
- Share a version-controlled Google Doc with named owners and a row for acceptance criteria
- Schedule a 45-min demo & alignment call (two proposed slots included in the doc)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmepay.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@acmepay.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: stakeholder onboarding checklist & timeline for Acme Payments

Thanks Stephanie — this is a helpful starting point. A few quick asks from our side: 

1) Please add a formal security/compliance checkpoint that lists the artifacts we require (SOC 2 Type II summary, retention policy, audit logs). Our security team needs a 2-week window to review evidence.
2) Procurement note: our internal purchasing deadline for Q1 commits is Jan 10. If the procurement milestone slips past Jan 10 we may need to target a Feb pilot start instead — can you indicate a hard procurement target?
3) Loop in our legal lead: contracts@acmepay.com (I’ve CC’d on this thread).

Also — can you include a short line in the MAP that states what success looks like for the pilot (e.g., X latency/throughput targets, sample prompts, and acceptance criteria)? That will help our ops team sign off faster.

I’ll review the doc tonight and send comments. Proposed demo slot: Dec 29 looks good for me, but I need to confirm with the engineering lead.

Date: 2026-12-21T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: stakeholder onboarding checklist & timeline for Acme Payments

Quick internal note — copying here so Jordan sees our alignment once we update the doc.

Jordan’s security ask is reasonable; propose we add a discrete milestone row: 
- Security evidence submission (owner: Acme), review window (owner: Redwood Sec — Dev Patel), review decision (owner: joint)

Resource suggestions for the MAP:
- Solutions engineer / pilot lead: Marissa Cole (I will be primary contact for pilot validation)
- Security engineer: Dev Patel (will own evidence review and follow-ups)
- Customer success / renewal: Sean Gallagher (longer-term SLA & usage metrics)

I’ll take the GDoc and add the milestone rows + a success criteria table (latency/throughput + sample prompt list). Will also add a gated sign-off checkbox for SOC2 evidence.

If anyone objects to the owners above speak up by EOD. Happy to ping security for a short sync if needed.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, Contracts <contracts@acmepay.com>
Date: 2026-12-22T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Updated MAP: stakeholder checklist + timeline (v1) — action items and demo slots

Jordan — thanks for the quick review and for looping legal. I incorporated Marissa’s edits and added the security/compliance checkpoint with a list of requested artifacts and a 2-week review window. I also added a short success criteria table (sample prompts + performance targets).

Updated doc (v1): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_acmepay_map_template
Slide summary (v1): https://drive.google.com/file/d/close-timeline-slides
HubSpot record: HS-2345678

Key open items for your confirmation:
- Procurement hard target: can you confirm Jan 10 as the preferred signature date? If that’s a hard constraint we’ll mark Jan 10 as the procurement row and accelerate legal handoffs.
- Demo timing: propose two windows — Dec 29 at 11:00 PT or Jan 5 at 10:00 PT. Which works best for your engineering lead?
- Any additional legal checklist items to add to the doc (contracts@acmepay.com) — if you prefer, happy to open a short SOW draft for procurement to review.

I will also attach a PDF export of the MAP into the thread for ease of sharing with execs (see attachments).

Thanks — once we have your procurement confirmation I’ll mark owners and freeze dates in the doc so we can move to scheduling.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
